name: Shanghai CEO Technology Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Founded in 2011 and based in Shanghai, China, Shanghai CEO Technology Co., Ltd. (which rebranded from Shanghai CEO Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. in May 2025) specializes in providing comprehensive environmental remediation solutions. The company offers advanced equipment and services primarily focused on two key areas: sludge management and waste gas purification. For sludge treatment, their offerings include sophisticated dehydration and drying technologies, notably integrated low-temperature vacuum systems. In the realm of air quality, they supply a variety of exhaust gas purification technologies, such as active oxygen ion systems, chemical treatment processes, biological filters, and molecular capture catalytic oxidation equipment. Beyond product provision, Shanghai CEO Technology is deeply involved in servicing urban and industrial park sewage treatment facilities. They also cover the full lifecycle of energy-saving and environmental protection technologies and equipment, from research and development and design to manufacturing, integration, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Their expertise extends to the purification of both odorous pollutants and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). The company further supports its clients with a range of specialized services, including carbon consulting, the development of emission reduction strategies, general equipment trading, comprehensive operation and maintenance services, and bespoke solutions tailored to specific needs.
